concerns.text: The plan explicitly targets OpenNeuro datasets ds003865, ds003392, and ds003775 for resting-state EEG analysis. However, the 'Verified Datasets Strategy' section admits the 'Verified datasets' block contains NO verified source for these specific raw EEG datasets, only derived formats or unrelated tasks. Proceeding with these specific IDs without confirming they contain the required raw voltage time-series (BIDS EEG) risks the entire pipeline failing at the download/parse stage or analyzing the wrong modality (e.g., structural MRI or derived features) which cannot support APF estimation.

The plan assumes 3-5 OpenNeuro datasets (ds003865, ds003392, ds003775) with ~60-100 subjects total. Given the admission in research.md that these specific IDs lack verified raw EEG sources in the provided block, the feasibility of the 'Scale/Scope' (N≥20 per dataset) is unproven. If these datasets are not resting-state EEG or lack sufficient subjects, the mixed-effects model (US-3) will be underpowered or impossible to run, invalidating the variance decomposition approach.
